---
title: "instability-path-following"
format: html
---

Running notes live in `log.md`; numbers in `metrics.json`; figures in
`results/`. This notebook only reloads the headline table.

```{python}
import json, pathlib
m = json.loads(pathlib.Path("metrics.json").read_text())
for k, v in m.items():
    if isinstance(v, dict) and "pass" in v:
        print(f"{k}  {'PASS' if v['pass'] else 'MISS'}  {v['name']}")
```
